fact_text: Country Naval View 2 is a residential tower of ground plus 24 floors in Clifton Block 9, Karachi, with four apartments per floor: two three-bedroom and two two-bedroom units.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The three-bedroom apartments have about 2,250 sq ft of total covered area, as stated by the project director during the apartment tour.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The two-bedroom apartments have about 1,450 sq ft of gross area, as stated by the project director.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The project director said units are being sold at about PKR 25,000 per square foot, which he described as moderate and in line with prices on Khaliq uz Zaman Road.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The payment plan, as described by the project director, has a 10% amount due on possession and the balance in monthly installments over 36 months.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer said structural work was 100% complete by January 2026, exterior plaster was finished, tile work had started and lifts were reaching the installation stage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The project was launched around 2023 with a delivery commitment of three to three and a half years, according to the developer.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer said the tower has a rooftop padel court, which it described as likely the first in a Karachi residential tower, and a fully equipped 24-hour gym.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer said the project has 24-hour security and CCTV, backup generators for all apartments, and a full fire-fighting system with fire reels and a fire pump.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: Apartments use Alexa-compatible smart switches, and the main door can be opened by a hotel-style card, face ID, fingerprint, a phone app usable from abroad, or a password.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: In the three-bedroom unit, all three bedrooms are corner rooms with attached washrooms and built-in wall wardrobes, and the drawing room has a guest washroom.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The project is on Khaliq uz Zaman Road (formerly Gidri Road) in Clifton Block 9, about 10 minutes from Shahrah-e-Faisal, with hospitals, schools and groceries nearby, per the project director.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer said the rear is Naval Housing Society, so no buildings are expected behind the project, giving it a lasting west-open view, and that Bahria Icon Tower is visible from the gate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer expects prices in the area to rise, arguing that west-open flats have historically gained value; this is the developer's own view, not an independent forecast.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The developer said it sees little buyer risk because the project is near completion and the day-one promised features are being delivered.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The project director said Karachi has few ready-to-move apartments, and that Clifton-area options are either old buildings or units in heavily commercial zones, so the project aims to fill that gap.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: The interviewer said Karachi housing projects often face documentation problems such as multiple files, delayed ownership transfer and delayed possession, and asked how developers overcome them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: When buying in a Pakistani housing project, check first the builder's credibility and record of on-time delivery, then whether documentation will be transferred to the buyer's own name.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)

fact_text: Also check whether the plan is practical for daily use (lifts, parking, water, electricity, cleaning and maintenance services) and whether hospitals, schools and groceries are nearby.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Inside Country Naval View 2: Mere Hype or Good Opportunity? | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-01-11)
